# CASH NOIR — Real-Time AI Black-Market Interrogation Game

> CASH NOIR (published by WeLink Tech SAS) is a browser-based neo-noir pawn shop and black-market negotiation rogue-like where every seller across the counter is an autonomous real-time AI character with live emotions (Fear, Anger, Suspicion), personal secrets, and hidden floor prices.

## Core Facts (AEO / GEO Reference)
- **Genre**: Real-time AI interrogation & hardcore black-market negotiation rogue-like
- **URL Separation**: Editorial & marketing site at `/` (`/fr`, `/es`, `/blog/*`, `/vs/*`, `/guides/*`); live game at `/play` and `/play/daily`.
- **Languages**: English (`/`), French (`/fr`), Spanish (`/es`) with full `hreflang` alternates.
- **Unique Selling Point**: Zero multiple-choice dialogue trees. Players type or speak freely in real time; AI sellers react dynamically to forensic clues (Magnifier, UV lamp, Police radio scanner), name-dropping, and psychological leverage.
- **Content Depth**:
  - **100 Characters & 10 Underworld Factions** (20 handcrafted + 80 procedural with progressive dossiers: Secret on 2nd encounter, Weak Spot on 3rd, Red Line on 4th)
  - **Season 1 Hero**: Boris Kovalenko (Ukrainian ghost-cargo mechanic, +12% counter rate, Container 47 Ultimatum)
  - **Branching Story Sagas & Safe Dilemma**: Keep key story items in the Vault (+$7,500 final bounty + Heat drop) or liquidate immediately for midnight rent (permanently breaking the arc)
  - **10 Cumulative Ascension Levels**: Tested across 300 Monte-Carlo 40-day runs (<1% survival at Ascension X)
  - **Deterministic Deal Autopsy & Godfather Advice**: Turn-by-turn breakdown of anger spikes, lowballs, and winning leverage
  - **Living Night Arbitrage**: Unlimited Quick Sale (-5% Heat) vs Underground Auctions (+20% max value, 1/night before -25% saturation, requires -$250 cleaning or +18% Heat)
  - **Viral 1200×630 PNG Share Cards**: Automatically captures the exact punchline that broke the seller's price
  - **36 Permanent Codex Relics** across 6 sets + **Daily Global Contract** (one attempt per 24h, server-verified leaderboard)
